title: Enchanted Javelin - PSV-015 - Yugioh - 1st Edition
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: This is a rare, 1st edition Enchanted Javelin card from the Legend of Blue Eyes White Dragon Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG set. The card has a super rare rarity, with a regular finish. It features an Angel creature/monster type and is a Trap card with the card number PSV-015. The card is in the standard size and English language, manufactured by T C G in 1996. The card is not autographed and is suitable for ages 16+. This vintage card is perfect for collectors and fans of the Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG.
